# PART 1 — THE OFFER

## 1. Market read (Starving Crowd)
Same starving crowd as Auxara — **sales SMBs / call centers** — but here the buyer is specifically the
**owner/manager who owns rep performance.** All four indicators strong: massive pain (reps leave deals on
the table; managers have no time to review calls), purchasing power (they pay per-rep for dialers/CRMs),
easy to target (by vertical + you already reach them), growing (AI-coaching category is expanding fast).
**Beachhead:** the same vertical as your Dialer/Coach proof — outbound sales teams / insurance-style call centers.

## 2. Value Equation read
| Driver | State | Lever |
|---|---|---|
| **Dream Outcome** ↑ | Strong | "Your whole team closes like your #1 rep." Tie to revenue, not "call scores." |
| **Perceived Likelihood** ↑ | **Superpower** | **Evidence-based** coaching (quote + timestamp + confidence), *not* generic sentiment. And the free teardown lets them SEE it work on their own call *before paying*. This is the whole game for AI coaching. |
| **Time Delay** ↓ | Strong | Coaching on the *next* call; new reps ramp in weeks not quarters. "See a rep's gaps today." |
| **Effort & Sacrifice** ↓ | Strong | **Zero manager hours** — the AI does the call review managers never have time for. |

**Weakest = Perceived Likelihood** (the universal AI-coaching objection: "will it be accurate, or generic
garbage?"). CoachAI's evidence-linking + the free teardown are built to destroy exactly that objection —
which is why the lead magnet below is the centerpiece of the whole plan.

## 3. The offer stack — the Final High Value Deliverable
Sell the transformation, not "call-scoring software." Stack (value `<anchored to a rep closing more>`):

| Bundle (kills a problem) | What's inside | Value |
|---|---|---|
| **① Every-Call Coaching Engine** — *"managers can't review every call"* | Every recorded call scored against **your** playbook, per-rep, evidence-linked (quote+timestamp+confidence) | `<$X/rep/mo>` |
| **② Done-For-You Playbook Setup** — *"generic scorecards don't fit us"* | We load *your* winning playbook + scorecard so coaching matches how *you* sell | `<$1,500>` |
| **③ Manager Command Center** — *"I don't know who to coach"* | Who-needs-coaching, the evidence, the action, follow-through tracking (the manager packet) | `<$X>` |
| **④ Owner Proof Dashboard** — *"is coaching even happening / working?"* | Is coaching happening, are managers following through, is the team improving — provable | `<$X>` |
| **⑤ Rep Practice System** — *"tell me the one thing + a line to practice"* | Per-rep improvement plan + practice lines from real calls | `<$X>` |
| **BONUS: Free onboarding + playbook build** | We set it up — no lift for you | `<$1,500>` |
| **BONUS: First 30 days coached free** | The trial/guarantee below | — |

**Total value ≫ price.** Each bundle maps to a real role's job from your PRODUCT.md (rep/manager/owner) — so
the offer sells the whole team, not a feature.

## 4. Enhancers
- **Scarcity (honest):** cap **white-glove onboarding** to `<N>` new teams per month (real capacity).

- **Bonuses (add, don't discount):** free playbook build, the free teardown (the lead magnet) as a bonus,

## 5. Guarantee (SaaS-appropriate risk reversal)
Two layers:
- **Try-before-you-buy (unconditional, low risk for you):** *"See CoachAI grade your team's first calls
  free. Cancel anytime — no contract."* (Low fulfillment cost per free analysis → an unconditional trial is safe.)
- **Performance (conditional, bolder):** *"If your team's `<scored metric — e.g. talk-time-to-close / playbook
  adherence>` doesn't improve in 90 days, we work with you free until it does (or refund)."* Only promise a
  metric you can move — validate against real cohort data first.

## 6. Pricing — SaaS structures (recommendations to validate)
Anchor: **one extra closed deal pays for the whole team's month.** Price on that value, not on cost.

### 🅰️ Recommended — Per-rep + team floor
- **`<$99>`/rep/mo** (annual) / `<$129>` monthly · **minimum `<5>` reps** · **one-time onboarding `<$1,500>`
  (waived on annual).** Owner/manager seats free. Simple, scales with the team, easy ROI story.

### 🅱️ Tiered team plans
- **Starter** `<$499/mo>` (up to 5 reps) · **Growth** `<$999/mo>` (up to 15) · **Scale** `<$1,999/mo>` (up to 40).
  Anchoring: 3 plans, middle featured. Good if you want predictable MRR bands.

### 🅲️ Land-and-expand
- **Free teardown → 14-day full-team trial → per-rep plan.** Product-led; the lead magnet *is* the top of funnel.

**All three:** annual = 2 months free (locks retention); never discount the per-rep rate — add onboarding/
bonuses instead. Anchor every quote to "what's a 10% higher close rate worth to you?"

# PART 2 — HOW TO ADVERTISE (the lead-gen plan)

## ⭐ The lead magnet — "Grade My Call" (your idea — and it's the best move you have)
Your upload-call → email-report pipeline is a **perfect Hormozi lead magnet**: it's a *sample of the core
product on the prospect's own data* (magnet type = **sample/trial + reveal-a-problem**). It hands them real,
evidence-based value before they pay — which is exactly the objection CoachAI needs to kill.

**The flow (prospect's experience):**
1. Land on **coach.auxara.io/grade** → "Get a free AI teardown of one sales call."
2. Upload a recording (or paste a transcript) → enter **email** (the capture).
3. CoachAI runs its **real analysis** → emails a **1-page report**: score vs. a standard framework, the
   **#1 gap with the exact quote + timestamp** (evidence = the wow), and **one practice line**.
4. **CTA:** *"That's one call. Coach every call for your whole team → start your free trial."*

**7-step build (per `hormozi-lead-magnet`):** narrow problem (reps leaking deals, managers can't hear every
call) → solve it with ONE real teardown → deliver as web-upload→email report → name/test "Grade My Call" →
easy (upload+email, report in minutes) → make it *great* (real evidence, one specific fix, a practice line —
over-deliver so they think "if the *free* one is this good…") → CTA into the trial.

### 🔧 What to build (you said code changes are fine — here's the slice)
Reuse the existing CoachAI analysis engine — **do not build a parallel analyzer.** New thin funnel on top:
- **Public landing page** `/grade` (unauthenticated) — upload + email capture. *(Frontend surface → mockup +
  your approval first, per your own rule, before I code it.)*
- **Backend endpoint:** accept upload → call the existing call-analysis pipeline → render a 1-page report →
  email it (transactional email) → store the lead (email, result, source) in a `leads` table → CTA link to signup.
- **Guardrails (important):** rate-limit + 1 free analysis per email (cost control on a public endpoint);
  file-size/type limits; **consent/PII** — uploading a call recording needs a "you have consent to upload
  this call" checkbox (compliance, since these are real customer calls); abuse/spam protection.
- **Analytics:** track upload→report→trial conversion (this is your CFA funnel).
This is one bounded slice (a funnel on existing capability), not a rebuild. I can spec + mock it next.

## The Core Four — sequenced (Rule of 100)
1. **Warm Outreach** — your network + existing Dialer/Coach contacts. "I'll grade one of your reps' calls
   free — want to see it?" Warmest path to first trials.
2. **Post Free Content (your strongest channel)** — LinkedIn is a *goldmine* here: post **anonymized call
   teardowns** ("here's what a $50k deal sounded like right before it died — and the one line that lost it").
   Every teardown is content AND proof AND a demo of the product. Hook · Retain · Reward; give freely, CTA to
   "Grade My Call." This channel + the lead magnet is CoachAI's flywheel.
3. **Cold Outreach** — targeted list of sales-team owners in your vertical; lead with a free teardown of one
   of *their* public calls / a Loom. Personalize + big fast value + volume + follow-up.
4. **Paid Ads** — ads → "Grade My Call" → trial → paid. **Call-Out + Value + CTA**; the trial→paid funds
   spend (**Client-Financed Acquisition**); scale only past **LTV:CAC ≥ 3:1.**

**Rule of 100** (100 actions/day, 100 days), master one channel before the next, then scale **More → Better → New**.

## Lead Getters (scale later)
- **Referrals:** managers refer other managers ("who else runs a team that'd want this?") + in-product ask.
- **Affiliates/Partners:** sales trainers, dialer/CRM vendors, fractional sales leaders who serve the same teams.
- **Employees:** as you grow, an SDR running the Core Four + a CS motion driving referrals.
